mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password_hash, enabled, create_time, edit_time, status FROM lamelo_agent_account WHERE username = #{username} AND status = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT id, username, password_hash, enabled, create_time, edit_time, status FROM lamelo_agent_account WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lamelo_agent_account (username, password_hash, enabled, create_time, edit_time, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{enabled}, NOW(), NOW(), 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE lamelo_agent_account SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, edit_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
UPDATE lamelo_agent_account SET enabled = #{enabled}, edit_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM lamelo_agent_role WHERE role_code = #{roleCode} AND status = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lamelo_agent_role (role_code, role_name, create_time, edit_time, status) VALUES (#{roleCode}, #{roleName}, NOW(), NOW(), 1)
INSERT INTO lamelo_agent_account_role (account_id, role_id, create_time, edit_time, status) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{roleId}, NOW(), NOW(), 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 1, edit_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT r.role_code FROM lamelo_agent_account_role ar INNER JOIN lamelo_agent_role r ON r.id = ar.role_id AND r.status = 1 WHERE ar.account_id = #{accountId} AND ar.status = 1 ORDER BY r.id
